"""OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop Demo manifest.

A polyglot microservice e-commerce demo illustrating OpenTelemetry
instrumentation across many languages and runtimes.

Architecture reference: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/demo/architecture/
Source: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-demo
"""

from scryr.manifest import Diagram, Link, Manifest
from scryr.saas import Classification
from scryr.types import (
    AuthType,
    CICDToolType,
    DeploymentTarget,
    IaCToolType,
    LogAggregationType,
    MonitoringType,
    ProgrammingLanguage,
    TracingType,
    Url,
    WebFramework,
    parse_version,
)

_SOURCE = Url("https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-demo")
_DOCS = Url("https://opentelemetry.io/docs/demo/")
_DEPLOYMENT = DeploymentTarget.k8s_cluster
_CICD = CICDToolType.github_actions
_IAC = IaCToolType.helm
_MONITOR = MonitoringType.prometheus
_LOGS = LogAggregationType.loki
_TRACING = TracingType.jaeger
kafka_block = Manifest(
    name="Kafka",
    icon="📨",
    classification=Classification.queue,
    tags=["messaging", "async", "infra"],
    connections=[],
    description="Apache Kafka message queue used for async order events between Checkout, Accounting, and Fraud Detection.",
    version=parse_version("3.6.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.java,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=3,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Demo Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
